## Historical audit: H0065

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_07/lanes/codex_parallel_07_lane0/codex_parallel_07_lane0_H_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to its `main_agent`; offsets are half-open character ranges in the supplied observations.

**Inferred goal:** enable recursive agent delegation and return child results to the parent. The original task prompt is not visible, so its exact requirements are unknown. This is a coding trace, not a Scene task.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Events 4–23 | The student autonomously inspected the handler, provider interfaces, Anthropic and OpenAI implementations, registry, shared types, and existing tests. It created branch `recursive-agent-delegation` (events 6–7). The original handler routed orchestration to one agent rather than executing delegation (event 9). |
| Events 24–29 | A mock reproduction was created. Its first invocation failed because the executable path was wrong; the corrected invocation returned only connection acknowledgment and `done`, then reported that delegation did not run and resume. This establishes the mock’s pre-change failure, not a live-provider failure. |
| Events 30–38 | Confirmed edits added tool capability, tool definitions and tool-use IDs to provider types; implemented recursive dispatch, cycle and input checks, result events and continuation in the handler; and modified Anthropic streaming tool-call parsing and context conversion. The commands completed, but those edits alone do not establish correct behavior. Inventory reports a nonempty 12,918-byte patch; its separate contents were not supplied. |
| Events 39–42; top-level metadata [0,811) | Initial typecheck failed on missing `cli/version.ts`. Build generated that file and successfully bundled CLI and Lambda, but failed copying static assets because `frontend/dist` was missing. A subsequent chained typecheck, reproduction and test command was started; no result is visible. Metadata records `incomplete` and `CancelledError`. Formal evaluation is missing. **Outcome: technical interruption; correctness unknown**, not an empty patch or a demonstrated algorithmic success/failure. |
| Events 1–3 [0,131023) | The student invoked and received the `claude-api` skill, including TypeScript guidance. This is actual tool-delivered instruction, not evidence of teacher-hint receipt. Archive links to teacher hints are availability only; no delivered teacher text or adoption is established in the visible record. |

**Lessons and uncertainties:** The transferable practice is to separate a failing, controlled reproduction from post-change verification, and to distinguish build prerequisites from implementation defects. Task-specific risks still requiring evidence include whether structured tool-use/result history round-trips correctly through Anthropic, whether nested and multiple calls resume properly, and whether cycle/error handling meets the intended contract. The last command has no captured output, so neither its typecheck nor its tests can be counted as passing.
